dfs=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); d=d.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy(); d['carrier']=os.path.basename(f)[:2]
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'; scol='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; acol='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d['datex']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]); d['sched_m']=d[scol].map(lambda x:int(x[:2])*60+int(x[3:]) if pd.notna(x) else None)
 d['actual_m']=d[acol].map(lambda x:int(x[:2])*60+int(x[3:]) if pd.notna(x) else None)
 d['delay_naive']=d.actual_m-d.sched_m
 dfs.append(d)
allf=pd.concat(dfs,ignore_index=True)
print('rows unique',len(allf),'date range',allf.datex.min(),allf.datex.max(),'cancel',allf.cancelled.value_counts().to_dict())
print('negative delay completed',allf.loc[~allf.cancelled,'delay_naive'].describe())
print(allf.loc[(~allf.cancelled)&(allf.delay_naive < -300),['flight_id','carrier','datex','sched_m','actual_m','delay_naive']].to_string(index=False))
# direct counts
c=allf[~allf.cancelled]
print('completed',len(c),'delayed naive',sum(c.delay_naive>15),'rate',100*sum(c.delay_naive>15)/len(c))

# correct rollover when clock difference strongly indicates next day; use <= -? inspect all negative less -300
allf['delay']=allf.delay_naive.where(allf.delay_naive>=-300,allf.delay_naive+1440)
# scheduled date Jan-Feb
x=allf[(allf.datex>='2025-01-01')&(allf.datex<'2025-03-01')]
c=x[~x.cancelled]
print('rows',len(x),'completed',len(c),'delayed',int((c.delay>15).sum()),'rate',round(100*(c.delay>15).mean(),10))
print('delay distribution',c.delay.describe())
# duplicates details
b=pd.read_csv('airlines/B6.csv'); print(b[b.flight_id.duplicated(False)].sort_values('flight_id').to_string(index=False))

events.notes: Combined all six carrier files, deduplicated repeated flight_id records, restricted to scheduled departure dates in January-February 2025, excluded 38 cancelled flights, and counted delays strictly over 15 minutes. Adjusted clock-time differences for departures after midnight before calculating the rate: 453 delayed / 1,891 completed = 24.0% rounded to 1 decimal.
